methodology.title: Scoring & ranking methodology
methodology.lead: No score or ranking on BONUVO is arbitrary: every operator is rated through a published rubric, and every verification date reflects a real check.

sections.title: 1. Ranking order rule
sections.body: Eligible offers for your country are ordered by local relevance, their verified score out of 10, and their latest verification date. No operator can pay to alter its score.

sections.title: 2. Transparent evaluation criteria
sections.body: Scores reflect weighted criteria: bonus terms clarity (wagering terms, minimum odds, expiry window), local payment availability, customer support quality, mobile stability, and valid licensing.

sections.title: 3. Freshness and zero fabricated badges
sections.body: "Verified today" is only shown when the verification check occurred on the same day. Otherwise BONUVO displays the exact date of the latest check.

sections.title: 4. Data-driven football predictions
sections.body: Probabilities displayed by BONUVO AI are calculated from real team statistics, locked prior to kickoff, and settled transparently including losses.

affiliation.title: Transparency & affiliate disclosure
affiliation.lead: BONUVO is an independent comparison media platform. Access remains free for visitors thanks to affiliate partnerships with licensed operators.

sections.title: 1. How BONUVO is funded
sections.body: When you follow an outbound link or use a partner promo code, BONUVO may receive a commission at no extra cost to you.

sections.title: 2. Editorial independence
sections.body: Partner outbound links are clearly disclosed. Each operator review also highlights an objective consideration whenever relevant.

sections.title: 3. Distinct measured facts
sections.body: Outbound clicks are tracked separately from partner registrations and confirmed first deposits.

responsible.title: Responsible gambling & 18+ notice
responsible.lead: Sports betting involves financial risk and potential addiction. BONUVO is strictly intended for adults aged 18 or older (or local legal age).

sections.title: 1. No guaranteed winnings
sections.body: No odds, promo code, or statistical analysis guarantees profit. Never wager money needed for essential living expenses.

sections.title: 2. Healthy betting habits
sections.body: Set a strict monthly limit before wagering, avoid chasing losses, and use self-limitation or self-exclusion tools provided by licensed operators.

sections.title: 3. Need support?
sections.body: If betting causes stress, isolation, or financial strain, contact local addiction support helplines in your jurisdiction. For a deposit, withdrawal, account access, KYC verification, bonus, or bet settlement issue with a partner operator, use the verified partner support center below.

privacy.title: Privacy policy & data protection
privacy.lead: BONUVO follows strict data minimization: public offer listings stay accessible without creating an account.

sections.title: 1. Essential preference cookies
sections.body: Your selected country and theme preference are stored solely in functional preference cookies without advertising trackers.

sections.title: 2. Privacy protection
sections.body: Our security logs anonymize IP addresses prior to storage to protect visitor privacy while preventing abuse.

sections.title: 3. Member rights
sections.body: From your member space, you can export your data at any time, withdraw communication consent in one click, or request full account deletion.
